nll_source_contrasts.definition: Gold answer NLL; positive contrasts mean higher loss, not more useful memory. Mixed caches are counterfactual and can be out of distribution.

interpretation: Reused-validation pathway diagnostic, not untouched confirmation. Natural prefix orders are semantically equivalent but their representations differ; mixed caches can be out of distribution and need not correspond to a realizable prefix. Functional rescue does not prove unique storage, ordinary write damage, or a new semantic interface. No absence-of-information claim from a failed transplant.
